title: Readme
review_role: Repository provenance, manuscript-specific citation instructions and distinction between manuscript dates and public release.
source_statement_scope: Pinned README confirms collection structure and versions/citations. Administrative verification states are not theorem verdicts.

title: A Fully Polynomial Randomized Approximation Scheme for Perfect Matchings in General Graphs
review_role: Unweighted perfect matchings in arbitrary finite simple undirected graphs; exact zero if infeasible; FPRAS with per-tape polynomial bit work.
source_statement_scope: Theorem 1.1 and Section 1.2; multi-coordinate lifted matching law. Not a blanket claim for arbitrary weighted partition functions.

title: Approximate counting of common bases of two matroids
review_role: Equal-rank common bases of two matroids supplied by exact independence oracles; polynomial oracle calls and outside-oracle bit work on every tape.
source_statement_scope: Theorem 1.1 and introductory proof strategy; paired encoding and quadratic transport.

title: An FPRAS for Common Integer Polymatroid Bases with Binary Capacities
review_role: Common integer bases, weight one per vector, binary capacities and exact rank-value oracles; avoids unary labelled expansion.
source_statement_scope: Theorem 1.1; polynomial outside-oracle bit work; source does not charge oracle internals as free practical computation.

title: An FPRAS for Cell-Bounded Contingency Tables
review_role: Arbitrary cell bounds including zero, binary numerical data, both dimensions varying; bounded-time approximate generation in Section 8.
source_statement_scope: Theorem 1.1 and Sections 1.2, 4–8. Binary-depth self-reduction is credited to source Section 8 and classical JVV, not presented as novel.

title: Exact Uniform Sampling of Contingency Tables with Arbitrary Margins
review_role: Exact unrestricted-table sampling in expected polynomial bit time; bounded approximation TV <= 2^-k.
source_statement_scope: Theorems 1.1 and 6.4, Sections 6.2–6.4. Transition budget d^200(k+b)^2 is per trial; total includes d^4(k+1) trials and exact-law correction cost. Cell bounds excluded.

title: Polynomial mixing of the switch chain for every graphical degree sequence
review_role: Lazy four-vertex simple-undirected chain: t_mix(1/4)<=2n^8, n>=4; separate expected-time exact sampler.
source_statement_scope: Theorem 1.1 and Corollary 1.2. Holds/rejected proposals counted; gap >= 1/(24n^2 choose(n,4)) for nontrivial state space.

title: Approximate counting and entropy of perfect matchings
review_role: Documented general-simple-graph FPRAS and selected entropy/triangle geometry.
source_statement_scope: Doc scope matches. It does not certify every global geometric statement in the manuscript. No independent Lean build performed.

title: Approximate counting of common integer polymatroid bases
review_role: Doc formal scope covers equal-rank matroid common bases with independence oracles, despite integer-polymatroid heading.
source_statement_scope: Doc’s linked statement is matroid, not the October binary-capacity integer-polymatroid extension. No independent build.

title: Sampling and counting contingency tables with arbitrary margins
review_role: Doc unrestricted exact/approximate sampling plus cell-bounded counting.
source_statement_scope: Exact cell-bounded sampling is not within documented sampling scope. No independent build.

title: Rapid mixing of graph switches for every degree sequence
review_role: Doc switch connectivity/mixing/gap for specified simple-undirected kernel.
source_statement_scope: Exact sampler Corollary 1.2 is manuscript scope, not documented family 131 coverage. No independent build.

title: Comparator challenges
review_role: Comparator checking instructions and limited review coverage.
source_statement_scope: Operational documentation. No check was executed; deliberate theorem placeholders are not presumed proof defects.

title: Random generation of combinatorial structures from a uniform distribution
authors: Mark R. Jerrum; Leslie G. Valiant; Vijay V. Vazirani
review_role: For self-reducible families, approximate counting and almost-uniform generation have polynomial-time reductions.
source_statement_scope: Original abstract and paper verify this framework. It does not mean every approximate sampler can be made efficiently exact without additional access.

title: A polynomial-time approximation algorithm for the permanent of a matrix with nonnegative entries
authors: Mark Jerrum; Alistair Sinclair; Eric Vigoda
review_role: FPRAS for permanent of nonnegative matrices, hence bipartite matching baseline.
source_statement_scope: Primary abstract matches; extension to all general graphs is not attributed to JSV.

title: Log-concave polynomials II: High-dimensional walks and an FPRAS for counting bases of a matroid
authors: Nima Anari; Kuikui Liu; Shayan Oveis Gharan; Cynthia Vinzant
review_role: Single-matroid basis FPRAS via log-concavity/high-dimensional walks and independence access.
source_statement_scope: Primary Annals abstract matches; common-basis intersection is distinguished.

title: Log-concave polynomials, I: Entropy and a deterministic approximation algorithm for counting bases of matroids
authors: Nima Anari; Shayan Oveis Gharan; Cynthia Vinzant
review_role: Deterministic exponential-in-rank approximation for bases and common bases.
source_statement_scope: Versioned arXiv abstract explicitly gives 2^{O(r)} factor; author publication list confirms journal metadata.

title: Lorentzian polynomials
review_role: Lorentzian structural framework for discrete generating polynomials.
source_statement_scope: Primary Annals paper/abstract supports structural background; no automatic common-base FPRAS is inferred.

title: On Counting Perfect Matchings in General Graphs
authors: Daniel Štefankovič; Eric Vigoda; John Wilmes
review_role: Obstruction for the familiar weighted perfect/near-perfect chain in general graphs.
source_statement_scope: Actual v1 authors/title/abstract verified: either perfect-matching mass inadequate or mixing slow, even with arbitrary hole weights. Not an impossibility theorem for all algorithms.

title: Sampling contingency tables
authors: Martin Dyer; Ravi Kannan; John Mount
review_role: Geometric/convex-body sampling for sufficiently large margins.
source_statement_scope: Primary Wiley abstract and original author manuscript; restrictions retained, not arbitrary-small-margin theorem.

title: Improved bounds for sampling contingency tables
review_role: Improves large-margin thresholds of geometric predecessor.
source_statement_scope: Publisher abstract states quantitative margin requirements; review does not claim universal sampling.

title: Polynomial time perfect sampling algorithm for two‐rowed contingency tables
review_role: Exact two-row sampler by monotone CFTP, reported expected O(n^3 log N).
source_statement_scope: Technical report Algorithm 2, Theorems 3.1/5.1 and runtime section use uniform real draws at unit cost. Review explicitly distinguishes that accounting from an audited unbiased-bit implementation.

title: Approximate counting by dynamic programming
venue: Proceedings of the thirty-fifth annual ACM symposium on Theory of computing
review_role: Fixed-row uniform sampling with dynamic programming and rejection.
source_statement_scope: Original ACM paper Section 3 verifies exact uniform generator; arithmetic-operation accounting and row-dependent exponents retained.

title: An FPTAS for #Knapsack and Related Counting Problems
authors: Parikshit Gopalan; Adam Klivans; Raghu Meka; Daniel Štefankovič; Santosh Vempala; Eric Vigoda
venue: 2011 IEEE 52nd Annual Symposium on Foundations of Computer Science
review_role: Fixed-row deterministic FPTAS with logarithmic numerical-margin dependence.
source_statement_scope: Author original PDF Theorem 1.3: exponent depends on row count, so not fully variable dimension guarantee.

title: Exact sampling and counting for fixed-margin matrices
authors: Jeffrey W. Miller; Matthew T. Harrison
review_role: Exact fixed-margin counting and sampling; complexity polynomial for fixed maximum column sum, practical examples.
source_statement_scope: Original author arXiv v2 journal reference and Theorem 3.3/Algorithm 3.4 verify scope; not a general binary-input polynomial-time counter.

title: Linear-time uniform generation of random sparse contingency tables with specified marginals
authors: Andrii Arman; Pu Gao; Nicholas Wormald
review_role: Exact sparse-table sampler with expected linear numerical-total work if 5 Delta^4<N.
source_statement_scope: Original IMS issue paper and author institution abstract verify condition. O(N) numeric-total complexity is not generally poly(log N).

title: Polynomial-time counting and sampling of two-rowed contingency tables
review_role: Two-row FPRAS and almost-uniform Markov-chain sampler.
source_statement_scope: Primary paper explicitly describes almost-uniform sampling, not exact sampling; primary journal metadata matches.

title: A polynomial-time algorithm to approximately count contingency tables when the number of rows is constant
venue: Journal of Computer and System Sciences
review_role: Fixed-row FPRAS for unrestricted tables.
source_statement_scope: Primary publisher abstract retains constant-row restriction; no variable-row extension inferred.

title: Approximately Counting Integral Flows and Cell-Bounded Contingency Tables
authors: Mary Cryan; Martin Dyer; Dana Randall
review_role: Cell-bounded table FPRAS when number of rows is constant.
source_statement_scope: Primary SIAM abstract directly states arbitrary row/column sums and bounds within constant-row restriction.

title: Sampling binary contingency tables with a greedy start
authors: Ivona Bezáková; Nayantara Bhatnagar; Eric Vigoda
review_role: Annealing algorithms for binary tables with arbitrary feasible margins.
source_statement_scope: Primary Wiley abstract states all row/column sums; this does not assert rapid mixing of the ordinary binary swap chain.

title: Generating graphs randomly
review_role: Survey of random graph generation and switch-chain regimes.
source_statement_scope: Author publication record verifies chapter metadata and notes missed Feder–Guetz–Mihail–Saberi 2006 Section 4.1/Corollary 6. Review retains author correction link; no false prior-history claim.

title: The mixing time of switch Markov chains: A unified approach
authors: Péter L. Erdős; Catherine Greenhill; Tamás Róbert Mezei; István Miklós; Dániel Soltész; Lajos Soukup
review_role: Rapid mixing for P-stable families across unconstrained, bipartite and directed models.
source_statement_scope: Actual author arXiv v5 abstract and journal reference verify; P-stability restriction retained rather than every graphical sequence.

title: Spectral Gap for the Binary Fixed-Margin Swap Chain
authors: Weibo Fu; Qian Qin; Guanyang Wang
review_role: General feasible binary fixed-margin lazy swap-chain gap >= 1/(choose(m,2) choose(n,2)), m,n>=2.
source_statement_scope: Actual v2 HTML Theorem 2.2 and kernel definition verified; 1/2 laziness, unordered row/column pairs. Bipartite model distinguished from symmetric simple-undirected adjacency.

title: An FPRAS for Counting Common Bases of Two Matroids
review_role: Common-base FPRAS and approximate sampling; soft-intersection and curvature method; unary-capacity integer applications.
source_statement_scope: Actual v1 Theorem 1.2 and Remark 1.3, Appendix C.9 Proposition C.20/Corollary C.21 verified. C.20 uses unary capacities; C.21 requires polynomial sum of capacities and log weight range, arithmetic model. Distinct from arbitrary binary capacities.

title: Perfect sampling from rapidly mixing Markov chains
authors: Andreas Göbel; Jingcheng Liu; Pasin Manurangsi; Marcus Pappik
review_role: Rare correction using approximate sampler plus usable exponential-time law and target evaluators.
source_statement_scope: Versioned v2 text explicitly needs output-law and target-distribution oracles; naive random-tape enumeration can invalidate the intended cost. Review includes exact evaluation/precision-cost guard.

title: Submodular Functions, Matroids, and Certain Polyhedra
review_role: Classical polymatroid/submodular-rank framework.
source_statement_scope: The verified Springer 2003 chapter preview gives the polymatroid definition and its rank-inequality characterization.

title: Algorithm AS 159: An Efficient Method of Generating Random R × C Tables with Given Row and Column Totals
review_role: Fixed-margin conditional-independence/Fisher sampler, contrasted with uniform tables.
source_statement_scope: Original JSTOR issue confirms metadata; SciPy official distribution documentation confirms target null law. The review derives 2x2 probabilities independently.

title: scipy.stats.random_table
review_role: SciPy fixed-margin independent-row/column null distribution and Patefield algorithm.
source_statement_scope: Actual version-specific header says SciPy v1.18.0 Manual; distribution description assumes row/column independence and lists Boyett/Patefield. It is not cited as uniform-on-tables software.

title: Probability Inequalities for Sums of Bounded Random Variables
venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association
review_role: Independent bounded [0,1] samples with Hoeffding deviation bound.
source_statement_scope: Original publisher abstract states independence and bounded ranges; review requires independent fresh/restarted draws, not consecutive correlated chain states.

title: Markov Chains and Mixing Times
review_role: Finite reversible lazy-chain spectral-gap/L2-to-TV relation.
source_statement_scope: Author-hosted second-edition text Chapter 12: laziness identifies ordinary with absolute gap, spectral contraction plus Cauchy–Schwarz yields displayed bound. Source supports theoretical bound, not transition-cost claim.
